description:
Unified AccuRanker Read + Write API v4. Sourced from app.accuranker.com/api/read-docs and /api/write-docs (Swagger 2.0 + OpenAPI 3.0 originals). Includes 21 endpoints across accounts, brands, prompts, domains, keywords, ranks, landing pages, tags, groups, async keyword jobs.

**Key behaviours:**
- Read endpoints REQUIRE the `fields` query parameter (GraphQL-like dot notation) or responses are empty objects.
- `period_from` and `period_to` query parameters scope historical data and are capped at 100 days per request.
- Dynamic filter DSL is available via POST body on list endpoints (100+ filter dimensions, 13+ comparators).
- Rate limits: 100 req/min, max 4 concurrent connections per IP.
- Plan-tier gates: LLM endpoints (brands/prompts) and overview endpoints return 200 with `{"error": ...}` or `{"message": ...}` when the caller's plan does not include them.

Expected body format: { 'filters': [ {'name': 'rank', 'comparator': 'lt', 'value': 10}, {'name': 'keyword', 'comparator': 'contains', 'value': 'test'} ], 'operator': 'and' }. Optional: fields, period_from, period_to (plus 4 more). Returns the new Organization.

tools.name: domain_create
tools.description: This endpoint creates a new domain for your group. A domain can only be created on groups or subaccounts authorized by the token. Set primary=true for a SearchSetting object you want to be primary for the domain. If the primary value is not set for any SearchSetting object, the first will be assigned as primary. Curl example: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' -d '{'domain':'DOMAIN_URL','default_searchsettings_names':[{'countrylocale':'en-GB','search_engine_names':[{'search_engine':'Google','search_type_names':['Desktop']}],'locations':['Buckingham Palace, London']}],'group_id':YOUR_GROUP_ID}' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/domain/. Required: default_searchsettings_names, domain, group_id. Optional: display_name, exact_match (default: false), facebook_profile (plus 7 more). Returns the new DomainSchemaOut.

tools.name: keyword_create
tools.description: With this endpoint, you can create one or more keywords on a domain. Keywords can only be created on domains authorized by the token on accounts that allow keyword exceedings. Go to https://app.accuranker.com/app/account to check if it is enable. If no search settings are provided, the default search settings from the domain will be used. This endpoint starts a job to import your keyword(s) - If you try to add existing keywords, these will be ignored. The response header 'Location' points to a specific endpoint for monitoring the progress status of your keyword job. Curl example: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' -d '{'domain_id': YOUR_DOMAIN_ID, 'keywords':['keyword 1', 'keyword 2']}' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/keyword/. Required: domain_id, keywords. Optional: description, enable_autocorrect (default: false), ignore_featured_snippet (default: false) (plus 5 more). Returns the new Message.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the keyword

params.name: domain_id
params.description: Id of the domain you want to add the keywords to

params.name: enable_autocorrect
params.description: Enable autocorrect for searches on this keyword

params.name: ignore_featured_snippet
params.description: Whether or not ranking on this keyword will ignore featured snippets.

params.name: ignore_in_share_of_voice
params.description: Whether or not this keyword should be ignored in aggregated share of voice

params.name: ignore_local_results
params.description: Whether or not ranking on this keyword will ignore local results.

tools.name: keyword_delete
tools.description: This endpoint deletes is used to delete a keyword - hence you should use this with caution. Curl example: curl -X DELETE -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' -d '{'keyword_ids':[YOUR_KEYWORD_IDS]}' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/keyword/. Required: keyword_ids. Returns the Message. Destructive.

params.name: keyword_ids
params.description: Ids of the keyword you want to delete

tools.name: keyword_update
tools.description: This endpoint updates settings for the given keywords. Only keywords on domains authorized by the token can be updated. Curl example: curl -X PUT -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' -d '{'keyword_ids':[YOUR_KEYWORD_IDS]}' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/keyword/. Required: keyword_ids. Optional: description, domain_id, enable_autocorrect (plus 5 more). Returns the updated Message.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the keyword

params.name: domain_id
params.description: Id of the domain you want to move the keywords to

params.name: enable_autocorrect
params.description: Enable autocorrect for searches on this keyword

params.name: ignore_featured_snippet
params.description: Whether or not ranking on this keyword will ignore featured snippets.

params.name: ignore_in_share_of_voice
params.description: Whether or not this keyword should be ignored in aggregated share of voice

params.name: ignore_local_results
params.description: Whether or not ranking on this keyword will ignore local results.

params.name: keyword_ids
params.description: List of keyword to update

params.name: starred
params.description: Mark the keyword as starred

params.name: tags
params.description: List of tags for the keyword. Used for filtering or grouping. Updating tags will overwrite existing tags on the keyword.

tools.name: overview_get-group-and-domains
tools.description: This endpoint returns a list of all accounts, groups and domains for your account. The list is based on the token provided. If you are looking for account_id, group_id or domain_id use this endpoint. Curl example: curl -X GET -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/overview/group_domains. Optional: include_subaccounts (default: false).

params.name: include_subaccounts
params.description: If true, it returns the accounts, groups, and domains for your subaccounts and your main account.

tools.name: overview_get-keyword-for-domain
tools.description: This endpoint returns a list of all your keywords on the provided domain. Curl example: curl -X GET -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/overview/keywords_for_domain/YOUR_DOMAIN_ID?keyword_contains=test. Required: domain_id. Optional: keyword_contains.

params.name: domain_id
params.description: Id of the domain to get keywords for.

params.name: keyword_contains
params.description: (Optional) Only returns keywords that contain the value (case-insensitive).

tools.name: prompt_create
tools.description: With this endpoint, you can create one or more prompts on a brand. Prompts can only be created on brands authorized by the token. If no countrylocale is provided, the default countrylocale from the brand will be used. This endpoint starts a job to import your prompt(s) - If you try to add existing prompts, these will be ignored. The response header 'Location' points to a specific endpoint for monitoring the progress status of your prompt job. Curl example: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' -d '{'domain_id': YOUR_DOMAIN_ID, 'prompts':['prompt 1', 'prompt 2']}' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/prompt/. Required: domain_id, prompts. Optional: countrylocale, description, starred (default: false) (plus 1 more). Returns the new Message.

params.name: countrylocale
params.description: Two letters combination of country and language. Defaults to the domain's default countrylocale if omitted. Example: en-GB (for english in Great Britain)

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the prompt

params.name: domain_id
params.description: Id of the domain you want to add the prompts to

params.name: prompts
params.description: List of prompts to add to the domain

params.name: starred
params.description: Mark the prompt as starred

params.name: tags
params.description: List of tags for the prompt. Used for filtering or grouping

tools.name: status_keyword-job
tools.description: Return status of an keyword job, given a job ID. To start a job call POST or PUT /keyword. Any response code other than 200 means the job is not finished or failed. Response code 200 means the job is finished and the keywords should be available on your domain. Curl example: curl -X GET -H 'Authorization: Token YOUR_API_TOKEN' https://app.accuranker.com/api/v4/status/keyword_job/YOUR_JOB_ID. Required: job_id. Returns the Message.

params.name: job_id
params.description: Job id
